0.title: Welcome to URDHVA
0.subtitle: 3D Cadastral Intelligence Platform
0.description: Transforming 2D land records into intelligent 3D spatial data — buildings, floors, underground infrastructure, and automated verification.

1.title: 3D City Visualization
1.subtitle: Every building mapped vertically
1.description: Each building is a 3D model with floor-wise ULPIN (Unique Land Parcel ID), basement levels, and underground parking — all spatially accurate.

2.title: Floor-by-Floor Exploded View
2.subtitle: Vertical property intelligence
2.description: Double-click any building to explode it — see individual floors, owners, violations, and 3D ULPINs. Each colored block = one family unit.

3.title: Underground X-Ray Mode
3.subtitle: See through buildings to infrastructure
3.description: X-Ray mode reveals water pipes, metro tunnels, gas lines, and sewers hidden beneath the surface — critical for infrastructure planning.

4.title: Subterranean Network View
4.subtitle: Deep underground infrastructure
4.description: Dive below ground level to inspect utility networks, detect unauthorized basements, and map ancient wells and buried structures.

5.title: Violation Detection
5.subtitle: Automated building compliance
5.description: Buildings exceeding sanctioned floor limits are automatically flagged in RED. Unauthorized basements and illegal excavations are detected instantly.

6.title: Infrastructure Clash Detection
6.subtitle: Spatial conflict radar
6.description: When planning new metro lines or pipelines, URDHVA detects 3D collisions with basements, foundations, and existing utilities — before construction begins.

7.title: Multi-Role Governance
7.subtitle: Citizen → Officer → Corporator → Builder
7.description: Each stakeholder sees role-appropriate data. Citizens get privacy-protected views. Survey officers create 3D maps. Corporators approve. Builders plan infrastructure.

8.title: Data & Survey → Corporator Workflow
8.subtitle: Region-based 3D map sharing
8.description: Survey officers create 3D maps from LiDAR/drone scans, then send them to the specific ward corporator. The corporator reviews, approves, and publishes to citizens.

9.title: URDHVA — Beyond the Surface
9.subtitle: Smart India Hackathon 2026
9.description: 2D records + 3D building intelligence + vertical property data + underground infrastructure + automated verification + spatial conflict detection = better decisions.
